evidence.quote: Jet engine afterburner trail producing a man-made polar light display.

Live-action, cinematic, a locked wide shot frames a dark, snow-covered arctic landscape under a star-filled night sky. A military jet streaks across the upper frame at high altitude, its engine glowing. The afterburner ignites, throwing a brilliant blue-white cone of flame. The exhaust trail expands and twists behind the aircraft, ionizing the thin upper atmosphere — the plume shimmers, shifting from orange-white at its core to luminous green and violet at its edges, mimicking an aurora.

criteria.rationale: The enhanced prompt preserves the cinematic, live-action medium and expands the visual style with realistic, high-contrast, volumetric glow effects consistent with the original concept. The 'man-made polar light' is rendered as a luminous, aurora-like phenomenon, which aligns with the requested aesthetic without introducing incompatible styles.
